descs.en: A detective with a glacier for a face. A diplomat who solved his paperwork in three languages and now sits on his desk until he looks at her.

ideaNote: Planned: 50 chapters. The Terminal · The Family · The Posting · The Return · Side stories.

synopsis.title: Synopsis
synopsis.content:
Detective Song Wei Long (no relation to the Songs of Milan; it’s a running joke he does not enjoy) is extraditing a suspect through a rain-soaked airport terminal when the paperwork collapses. A Canadian foreign-service officer called Isla Ren steps in and fixes it in three languages, and then looks at him as if he were the interesting part.

He works late. He always works late. She turns up anyway, sits on his desk, and blocks his files until he kisses her. Then her posting abroad comes through, and the man who has never asked anyone for anything has to decide whether to ask her to stay.

authorNote.title: Author Note
authorNote.content:
Wei Long is the only one allowed to be called Glacier in this series. He doesn’t know he’s lonely until somebody sits on his desk. Isla is bold and direct about what she wants, and teaches him to say it.

Dry humour, real police work and a slow thaw. The heat is in eye contact, desks, and a jacket left over a chair.

chars.name: Song Wei Long
chars.loveLanguage: Pulling her onto his lap without looking up from the file
chars.appearance: Tidy, cold-faced, a jacket that never comes off at work.
chars.personality:
Raised his cousin Yu Chen after their parents died
Lives by protocol
Doesn’t know how to say what he wants
chars.strengths:
Integrity you can set a watch by
Never drops a case
chars.weaknesses:
Works until there’s nothing left
Thinks loneliness is just quiet
chars.favHabit: Signing twelve more pages of testimony before he lets himself stop

chars.name: Isla Ren
chars.appearance: Warm, quick, Western-direct; switches the police scanner off when she walks in.

Born and raised in Vancouver
Says exactly what she wants, out loud
The only person who can make the Glacier laugh

Solves anything in three languages
Afraid of none of the city’s names
chars.weaknesses:
Hates waiting more than anything
A posting every two to four years
